scope: Incremental furnishing placement and installed arcade fabric review. No human, photoreal, whole-region, navigation, gameplay or V2 completion acceptance. Warm exposure, simplified stock, fascia, clock-face and broader finish work remain open.

images.observation: Parcel rack and retained stock stand clear of the baseboard; the room keeps its adjoining rack and wall finish.
The full wardrobe remains between the window and door with floor contact and a visible stand-off from the wall trim. Broader finish polish remains open.
The fabric sample rail is rehung above the eye rail and the cabinet below; its wall bearings are checked separately in the same production run.
The low potting case and specimen move together; shelf feet, pot and retained display stay assembled beside the finished wall.
The framed lobby piece clears the horizontal eye rail and remains seated on the plaster above the wainscot.
The dress form sits farther inside Lena's room, clear of the wall trim and radiator service path; the physical removal/carry/replacement proof tests that access separately.
The landing piece clears the eye rail above the continuous public panelling; this capture supplies no route acceptance.
The native bookcase retains its floor bearing and contents, with the baseboard continuing behind its separated rear envelope.
Both small frames sit below the eye rail without intersecting it; their wall plane and neighbouring table remain intact.
The studio board is rehung below the eye rail, above the floor trim and beside the existing working furniture.
The upper cupboard is raised slightly above the eye rail, leaving the sink and faucet installation in place.
The workshop board is rehung above the eye rail; the tool display and workbench remain together in the view.
The wardrobe is separated from the baseboard while retaining its doors, feet and adjacent storage. Overall material appearance is not accepted as finished.
Bed frame, mattress and bedding remain assembled after the wall stand-off adjustment; nearby bedside furniture remains visible.
The prep cabinet and independently mounted light table move as one installation; supported stock remains on the counter beside the stove.

The new faceted barrel glazing follows the retained ribs and replaces the former horizontal slab glass. The retained lantern now has a fitted stepped roof and real top-light well; fascia finish remains open.
Carried light shows separate eased clay faces and recessed mortar joints. Pigment and calibrated physical relief remain separate inputs.
Diffuse inspection shows individual brick edges and mortar depth at the throat, with the existing ceiling stock above.
Carried light shows fine terrazzo aggregate without the former broad repeated grime marks; the cart and doorway stock remain.
Diffuse light retains the same aggregate scale and floor field. Physical UV scale and complete loaded mip chains are checked separately.
Fitted lantern panes sit over the barrel shoulders; rib, curb, stepped roof and clock ownership remain visible.

The stepped roof has a real well beneath the retained top light. Folded skins, tier frames and the clock cross-tie replace the original solid slabs; composed geometry and bearing rays check the actual imported stock.
The closed arch gable follows the barrel rather than the former stepped rectangular glass; existing fascia and the newly fitted lantern roof remain.
The composed arcade retains its shops, open leaves, cart and framing with the new floor and roof stock. This is not played access or photoreal acceptance.
The portal view retains the entrance structure, continuous wall panelling and new brick face stock; remaining framing and fascia polish stay open.
The wider throat view shows the replacement masonry, continuous lower panelling and retained overhead structure together.
